notes: Two determiners are written before *day*, so each morpheme takes the one standing before its own word: the written *the* goes to the present article s008 and *same* to the demonstrative pronoun `הוּא`, leaving the agreement article `unrepresented` (rules 29, 41, 47).
s007 `בַּ` is `unrepresented`: the ASV writes the temporal phrase as a bare English adverbial accusative and spends no word on the preposition's own relation (rule 40).
